question: Is the orange box all of that note's stem, and does the note carry a flag, a beam, or neither?
note: He said 'Tile 7 ... Tile 9 ... Tile 10 ... Tile 11 ... that was 10. Tile 11 is two half notes': four 'eighth note, has a flag' answers then the half notes; by the pictures those four are tiles 7, 8, 9, 10 (our matching; tile 8 not confirmed by number).

answers.1: an eighth note, that is the entire stem, and it does have a flag
answers.3: an eighth note, it does have a flag, that is the entire stem
answers.4: eighth note, entire stem, does have a flag
answers.5: eighth note, entire stem, it does have a flag
answers.6: an eighth note, it does have a flag
answers.8: eighth note, has a flag [by our matching]
answers.11: two half notes, and it does have the entire stem in the box
answers.12: an eighth note, entire stem is in the box, and it does have a flag

scored_ours: flag right on 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 12 (were written beamed); stem ink right on all 12 he spoke to; 2 WRONG: a quarter note written a flagged eighth (was written beamed: wrong before and after); 8: he reads an eighth with a flag, we write a 16th -- to confirm with him; 9, 10, 11 stems now read, right
